display.purpose: The opening headline only; three uppercase lines at wall scale.

headline.purpose: One per field, fitted by script to the column width and a share of viewport height.

title.purpose: Type on tape: the action strip and landmark strips.

numeral.purpose: Tabular point values on the score sheet.

wordmark.purpose: Lowercase rocodrom. with its dot; rail mark and footer.

lead.purpose: The one sentence under the opening headline, max 33ch.

body.purpose: One short paragraph per field, max 34ch.

tag-value.purpose: Value column of a route tag.

label.purpose: Uppercase term column of a tag and score-sheet group names; the size floor.

hand.purpose: A setter note of a few words, rotated -2deg.

shadows.name: tag
shadows.purpose: A laminated tag hanging just off the wall.

shadows.name: tag-hole
shadows.purpose: The punched hole of a tag, showing the field colour.

shadows.name: phone
shadows.purpose: The device body, with a faint inner edge for the black field.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing for every CSS transition; GSAP entrances use the matching expo.out. No overshoot.

motion.name: duration-fade
motion.purpose: Opacity of tooltip labels and the language menu.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Chip hover and colour inversion, arrow slide.

motion.name: duration-settle
motion.purpose: Action tape straightening, legend square fill and scale.

motion.name: duration-screen
motion.purpose: Screen swap inside the pinned phone.

motion.name: entrance-line-rise
motion.value: yPercent 112 to 0, 1s to 1.1s, stagger 0.08s to 0.09s, expo.out, once
motion.purpose: Headline lines rising out of their mask.

motion.name: entrance-follow
motion.value: opacity 0 and y 18px to rest, 0.9s, stagger 0.08s, expo.out, once
motion.purpose: Paragraph and action following the headline.

motion.name: entrance-tag-swing
motion.value: rotate -9deg and y 26px to rest, 1.2s, expo.out, once
motion.purpose: Route tag swinging to rest from its clip.

motion.name: scrub-panel-cut
motion.value: scaleY 2.3 to 1 between top bottom and top 45%, linear scrub
motion.purpose: Diagonal wedge settling as a field takes the screen.

motion.name: scrub-phone
motion.value: rotate 6.5deg to 0 over the first field, then lean of 1.6deg alternating per field
motion.purpose: The pinned phone straightening and leaning.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Score numerals counting to their value.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transitions and animations 0.01ms; no GSAP; parade becomes a static grid

components.name: Action tape

components.html: Unirme a la beta

components.css: .ds-field-azul { background: var(--c3, #4F8AD9); padding: 44px 28px 32px; } .ds-tag { position: relative; display: inline-block; background: var(--chalk, #F4F6F8); color: var(--ink, #14171C); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 26px 20px 58px; min-width: 320px; max-width: 460px; rotate: 1.5deg; transform-origin: 30px 30px; box-shadow: 0 18px 30px -18px rgba(20, 23, 28, .55); font-family: var(--text, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tag::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 20px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c3, #4F8AD9); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgba(20, 23, 28, .35); } .ds-tag::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 25px; top: -20px; width: 8px; height: 42px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--ink, #14171C); rotate: 7deg; transform-origin: 50% 100%; } .ds-tag dl { margin: 0; } .ds-tag dl > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(84px, auto) 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: baseline; padding: 9px 0; } .ds-tag dl > div + div { border-top: 1.5px solid rgba(20, 23, 28, .16); } .ds-tag dt { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; font-stretch: 88%; } .ds-tag dd { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.38; } .ds-hand { font-family: var(--hand, 'Shantell Sans', cursive); font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.32; margin: 10px 0 0; rotate: -2deg; transform-origin: 0 50%; }

components.name: Legend rail

narrative.overview:
The page is one gym circuit. Eight full-bleed colour fields run from white to black, the same order a climber reads the grades on the wall, and each field carries one move of the game. Everything on a field is printed in a single ink; the only paper is chalk white, and it appears as an object hung on the wall (a laminated tag, a label, a menu), never as a tint. Colour does the dramatic work that shadows, gradients and illustration do elsewhere.

The objects are gym objects. Route tags are laminated cards clipped to a hold. Actions and landmarks are strips of gaffer tape with torn ends. A fixed ink rail on the left is the circuit legend, eight squares that fill as the reader climbs. One phone stays pinned on the right while the fields change behind it and its screen swaps to the real app screen for each move. Type is a condensed black grotesque at wall scale, set against very small tag labels, with a marker hand reserved for setter notes. Fields meet on a slight diagonal, like the facets of a wall.

Motion is calm and directional: lines rise out of a mask, tags swing to rest from their clip, panel cuts settle as a field takes the screen. Everything decelerates on one exponential ease-out and nothing overshoots. The system is dense with type and colour and sparse with components: there are no cards, no icon rows and no decorative imagery. The only things allowed their own colours are the real app screens and Crux.
keyCharacteristics: Eight full-bleed colour fields in fixed order, white to black, one idea per field.
One ink on every field; chalk is paper, not paint.
Wall-scale condensed uppercase headlines fitted to the column, against 11.5px tag labels.
Things hung on the wall (tags, tape, phone) are tilted and cast a soft shadow; things printed on the wall are level and flat.
Diagonal panel cuts between fields, alternating direction.
A fixed frame (legend rail and two chips) that never moves while colour floods beneath it.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every field prints in Ink only. Emphasis comes from size, weight and width, never from a second text colour. Measured against the build, Ink holds 4.88:1 on Rojo, 5.04:1 on Morado and 5.11:1 on Azul, the three tightest fields.

rules.name: The Chalk Is Paper Rule
rules.body: Chalk type never sits directly on fields 2 to 7 (it measures 2.1:1 to 3.4:1 there). Chalk appears on colour only as a surface carrying ink, or as type on an ink surface such as tape.

rules.name: The Field Order Rule
rules.body: The eight colours appear in circuit order and each appears once. A new section does not get a new hue; it takes the next field or shares one.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: 62% width is for the wall: headlines, tape, numerals, the wordmark. Normal width is for reading. Do not set running text condensed, and do not set a headline at normal width.

rules.name: The Fill The Panel Rule
rules.body: A headline is sized by its column, not by a step on a scale. Break it into lines by hand so every line is roughly the same length, then let the widest line reach the column edge.

rules.name: The Accent Clearance Rule
rules.body: At 0.88 line-height, uppercase accents collide with the line above. Every line is masked with 0.15em of headroom so accents are not clipped, and a line carrying an accented capital is set about 0.105em lower than the rhythm, rather than loosening line-height for the whole block.

rules.name: The Hung, Not Printed Rule
rules.body: If an element is an object on the wall it gets a tilt and may get a shadow. If it is printed on the wall it gets neither. Tape is the exception that proves it: stuck flat, so tilted but shadowless.

dos: Do give each new idea the next field in circuit order and print it in Ink (#14171C); on Negro, print in Chalk.
Do size headlines to fill their column, in hand-broken lines of similar length, uppercase, Archivo 900 at 62% width, line-height 0.88.
Do keep a field to headline, one paragraph of at most 34ch, and one object.
Do put facts in a route tag as term and value rows, and numbers that matter in Numeral style on a ruled row.
Do tilt anything hung on the wall by 1.5 to 3 degrees and alternate the direction field to field; keep printed type level.
Do use one easing for everything, cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), and let entrances play once.
Do keep every state visible without scripts or motion: content is laid out and readable first, and animation only removes an offset.
Do show the app with real captures inside the Ink device, and Crux as the live figure.
donts: Don't set Chalk type directly on fields 2 to 7; it fails contrast on every one of them.
Don't use a field colour as a text colour, button fill or outline on another field. The legend square and the tag hole are the only places a field colour appears off its own field.
Don't introduce a ninth hue or reorder the eight.
Don't separate fields with a horizontal edge or a rule; they meet on the diagonal.
Don't put a shadow under type, tape or a field. Shadows belong to the tag, the phone and popovers.
Don't round the ends of tape or square the corners of laminate.
Don't use bounce, overshoot or shake in any motion.
Don't set running text at 62% width, or labels below 11.5px.
